thesis: The podcast argues that major U.S. telecommunications carriers have been fully infiltrated by Chinese hackers, granting access to lawful intercept systems and live communications, which necessitates a clean install of a secure network on top of existing physical infrastructure. It introduces Cape as a global cellular network designed to be more private, secure, and resilient than commercial carriers, having been developed with early support from the U.S. Navy and the American Dynamism team to address these industry-wide cybersecurity failures.
